name: Behalf.bot - Disk map
description: On-demand disk usage treemap. Scans the host with du and renders a zoomable page into briefings/ so the briefing-server serves it.

roots.description: Colon-separated directories to scan (DISK_MAP_ROOTS). Defaults to $HOME plus the usual OS-level space holders (/opt, /Applications, /Library, /private/var on macOS; /opt, /var, /usr, /srv on Linux).

_chassis_v1_notes.shell_implementation: Plugin ships one Python script (stdlib only) plus an HTML template. contracts.tools -> installer can invoke plugins/disk-map/scripts/disk-map.py on the HOST (du inside the container only sees bind mounts).
_chassis_v1_notes.compat_bundle: See .claude-plugin/plugin.json for the Claude Code compatibility shim.
